tagline: Their own cool spot for summer: air moves underneath and takes the heat with it.
lead: On hot days your dog gets a cool place of their own, instead of the coolest tile in the house.
value: It cools the simple way, with airflow: no gel to puncture, no batteries to recharge, nothing inside to leak or run flat.
intro: Breeze is a raised cooling dog bed: a taut mesh deck on a steel frame, lifted clear of the floor, in Medium, Large and XL. There's no cover to wash.
points: Warm air moves away from under them instead of building up beneath.
Taut mesh takes their weight across the whole deck.
No gel, no batteries and no foam filling.
Wipe or rinse it. There's nothing to unzip or fight back on.
Useful in the garden all summer and in a warm kitchen all winter.
best_for: Hot sleepers, thick-coated breeds, and summers in a house with no air conditioning.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The whole deck is usable sleeping space. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Wipe or rinse the mesh and frame, then let it dry fully. Keep it on a level surface and check the frame joints occasionally.
seo_title: Elevated Cooling Dog Bed, No Gel or Batteries | Snoozly
seo_description: A raised cooling dog bed that works with airflow, not gel: a taut mesh deck on a steel frame, with no cover to wash. Medium, Large and XL.
